archiveTitle: 日报｜Nex Playground融资超1.5亿美元，计划2027年进入日本

decisions.headline: Nex Playground融资超1.5亿美元，计划2027年进入日本和韩国
decisions.summary: Nex宣布为业务扩张筹得超过1.5亿美元的股权融资与信贷额度；其体感游戏主机Nex Playground累计销量已突破100万台，并计划于2027年进入日本和韩国市场。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON已打开并转述Nex的融资、销量及2027年日本/韩国市场计划。
decisions.reason: 属于硬件与公司扩张的重要产业信息，来源时间明确落在固定窗口内。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 协力破坏巨蛋游戏《CRACK》公布，定于10月27日登陆PC
decisions.summary: 个人开发者Rafoli公布1至4人协力增量冒险游戏《CRACK》；玩家将在研究设施中逐步敲碎巨大蛋壳并探索设施秘密，PC（Steam）版计划10月27日推出。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON与電ファミニコゲーマー两家独立媒体均确认作品、1至4人协力玩法、Steam平台与10月27日日期。
decisions.reason: 两家独立来源一致，且属于本期明确的新作公布与定档。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 《电锯甜心》真人电影公布，将讲述游戏本篇之前的前传故事
decisions.summary: Dragami Games确认《Lollipop Chainsaw》真人电影正在制作，影片定位为R级动作喜剧，以Juliet为主角并讲述原作游戏之前的前传故事；演员阵容与上映日期尚未公布。
decisions.verification: IGN已打开，正文直接引用Dragami Games及项目相关制作方对真人电影的确认与定位。
decisions.reason: 知名游戏IP的正式影视改编公布，信息增量明确且时间在窗口内。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 东京电玩展2026因台风取消9月21日第五天全部活动
decisions.summary: CESA宣布，受台风接近、强风暴雨及公共交通风险影响，东京电玩展2026原定9月21日举行的第五天活动全部取消；本届原计划以五日会期庆祝30周年。
decisions.verification: Gematsu已打开并完整转述CESA取消第五天活动的公告与安全原因。
decisions.reason: TGS会期临时变更直接影响大型行业活动，属于本期应收录的产业信息。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 《鸣潮》3.7版本“幻梦迷光，心之所向”定于9月30日上线
decisions.summary: 库洛游戏确认《鸣潮》3.7版本将于9月30日上线，新增主线与伴星任务、新区域、两名共鸣者Hsin与Suoming、多种新声骸与活动内容。
decisions.verification: Gematsu已打开并转述Kuro Games对3.7版本日期与主要新增内容的公告。
decisions.reason: 大型持续运营游戏的明确版本定档与内容更新，属于可独立发布的本期新闻。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 《控制：共振》媒体评分解禁，Metacritic均分暂为84分
decisions.summary: 《控制：共振》媒体评分提前解禁；3DM汇总显示，基于56家媒体评测的Metacritic均分暂为84分，高于初代整体82分；IGN与Push Square均给出8/10。
decisions.verification: 已打开3DM汇总页，评分数字与多家媒体评价均来自该页；按媒体报道处理，不将聚合均分表述为官方数据。
decisions.reason: 大型作品评测解禁具有独立信息价值，且来源发布时间明确位于本期窗口。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 工厂自动化防卫游戏《BELTFED》公布，计划2027年登陆PC
decisions.summary: Hello World Studios正式公布《BELTFED》。玩家需要建设输送带、冶炼与生产设施，把自动化工厂转化为防线，对抗规模可达数十万只的虫群；游戏计划2027年登陆PC（Steam）。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON已打开并转述开发商正式公布的信息、核心玩法、平台和2027年发行计划。
decisions.reason: 机制鲜明的新作正式公布，证据与窗口归属明确，达到可收录阈值。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 《Shangri-La Frontier: Nanatsu no Saikyoshu》公开TGS玩法详情
decisions.summary: Netmarble在TGS 2026媒体发表会上介绍这款改编RPG：作品将还原原作世界并加入原创外传剧情，“七大最强种”被定位为终局内容；游戏面向PC、iOS与Android开发。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON已打开并现场报道TGS媒体发表会，正文包含玩法定位、平台与开发状态。
decisions.reason: TGS现场提供了可独立成稿的机制与内容增量，达到可收录阈值。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 《NieR》系列两套游戏与原声捆绑包登陆Steam
decisions.summary: Square Enix于9月19日在Steam推出两套《NieR》系列游戏与原声音乐捆绑组合，并同步开启发行纪念促销。
decisions.verification: 4Gamer已打开，正文明确记录Square Enix于2026年9月19日推出两套Steam捆绑包。
decisions.reason: 新商品组合正式上线且packet已判定处于本期窗口，达到可收录阈值。
decisions.timeNote: packet已确认该事实位于固定窗口内；来源仅支持日期，不反推具体时刻。

decisions.titleEn: Mobile Suit Gundam Extreme Vs. 2 Infinite Boost
decisions.headline: 《机动战士高达 EXVS.2 Infinite Boost》公布9台既有机体平衡调整
decisions.summary: TGS 2026的4Gamer舞台公开《机动战士高达 Extreme Vs. 2 Infinite Boost》调整信息，包括强袭高达、百式等9台既有机体的平衡改动。
decisions.verification: 4Gamer已打开并记录TGS 2026舞台公布的9台既有机体平衡调整。
decisions.reason: 直接影响现行竞技游戏环境的平衡更新，packet确认处于本期窗口。
decisions.timeNote: packet已确认该事实位于固定窗口内；来源仅支持日期，不反推具体时刻。

decisions.summary: 光荣特库摩在TGS 2026舞台公布，《真·三国无双2 with 猛将传 Remastered》将在发售后的更新中加入在线双人游玩功能。
decisions.verification: 4Gamer已打开并记录光荣特库摩TGS舞台公布的发售后在线双人更新计划。
decisions.reason: 经典作品重制版新增在线双人属于明确的功能增量，packet确认处于本期窗口。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Nex Playground raises over $150 million

entries.headline: Nex Playground raises over $150 million, plans Japan and South Korea launch in 2027
entries.summary: Nex said it secured more than $150 million in equity financing and credit facilities. Nex Playground has passed one million units sold, with launches in Japan and South Korea planned for 2027.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relayed Nex's funding, sales and expansion announcement.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Co-op egg-breaking game CRACK announced for PC, launches October 27
entries.summary: Rafoli announced CRACK, a one-to-four-player incremental adventure about breaking open a giant egg and exploring a mysterious laboratory. The Steam release is planned for October 27.
entries.verification: Two independent opened media sources agree on the game, platform, player count and date.
entries.timeNote: Both source timestamps fall inside the fixed Daily window.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: Lollipop Chainsaw live-action film announced as a prequel
entries.summary: Dragami Games confirmed a live-action Lollipop Chainsaw film is in development as an R-rated action comedy and prequel centered on Juliet; no cast or release date has been announced.
entries.verification: IGN directly reported Dragami Games' confirmation and project description.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Tokyo Game Show 2026 cancels its fifth day due to typhoon
entries.summary: CESA cancelled all Tokyo Game Show 2026 activities planned for September 21 because of expected strong winds, heavy rain and transport disruption from an approaching typhoon.
entries.verification: Gematsu relayed CESA's full cancellation notice.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Wuthering Waves Version 3.7 launches September 30
entries.summary: Kuro Games set Wuthering Waves Version 3.7 for September 30, adding new quests, an area, Resonators Hsin and Suoming, Echoes and events.
entries.verification: Gematsu relayed Kuro Games' Version 3.7 announcement.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: CONTROL Resonant review embargo lifts with an 84 Metacritic average
entries.summary: A 3DM review-score roundup reported CONTROL Resonant at an 84 Metacritic average from 56 reviews at publication time, with IGN and Push Square each awarding 8/10.
entries.verification: The opened 3DM page is treated as a media report rather than official score data.
entries.timeNote: The page timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Factory-automation defense game BELTFED announced for PC
entries.summary: Hello World Studios announced BELTFED, a roguelike tower-defense game about automating factories and weapons against insect hordes numbering in the hundreds of thousands. A PC Steam release is planned for 2027.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relayed the developer's announcement, gameplay premise, platform and release year.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Shangri-La Frontier: Nanatsu no Saikyoshu details its RPG design at TGS 2026
entries.summary: Netmarble's TGS presentation detailed an RPG that recreates the source world's setting, adds original side stories and positions the Seven Strongest Species as endgame content. It is in development for PC, iOS and Android.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's opened report records the TGS presentation and platform details.
